'''Mama{{'s}}''' was an establishment on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] owned by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] known as [[Mama (information broker)|Mama]]. It was the closet thing to a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] guild that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
